title: Add diagnostics and support bundle contract
purpose: Define diagnostics and support bundle contracts so operators can export useful evidence without leaking secrets.
scope: Define health snapshot, runtime diagnostics, support bundle manifest, audit excerpt, and redaction report shapes.
Define what can be included by default and what requires explicit approval.
Define deterministic bundle hashing and reproducibility expectations.
Define denial behavior for secret-like or untrusted fields.
implementation_steps: Define diagnostics and support bundle schema.
Classify fields into always-allowed, redacted, approval-required, and forbidden.
Record evidence with fixture cases for valid and secret-like diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Support bundles contain metadata and redacted audit excerpts, not raw secrets.
Operators can trace bundle contents to audit/run IDs.
Secret-like fixtures are rejected or redacted before export.
verification: Run future support bundle smoke script once implemented.
Run `cargo test --workspace` after contract code changes.
failure_modes: Support bundle includes raw secret-like values.
